blocks.text: Whalley Homes for Sale | Surrey BC MLS

parts.t: Whalley is the heart of North Surrey, and it takes in Surrey City Centre, the towers around Surrey Central, and older streets of houses and townhomes around them. It has three SkyTrain stations, which few Fraser Valley neighbourhoods can say. This page lists every home for sale in Whalley.

I've been in real estate since 2015 and I'm ranked in the top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors. I grew up on a farm in Langley and moved back there, and I spend plenty of time helping buyers compare City Centre buildings. Read my
Whalley neighbourhood guide
or compare all
North Surrey homes for sale
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®
The City of Surrey says the name comes from Arthur Whalley, who set up a gas station and store at the corner that became known as Whalley's Corner in 1925.
Gateway, Surrey Central and King George stations are all on the Expo Line here. The Surrey Langley SkyTrain will extend the line east from King George, with service expected in late 2029.
Holland Park, about 10 hectares on Old Yale Road, hosts many of Surrey's big outdoor events. Whalley Athletic Park and the Chuck Bailey Recreation Centre are nearby.
Kwantlen Park Secondary serves much of Whalley, along with elementaries such as Old Yale Road, Forsyth Road and K B Woodward. Check the address in the Surrey Schools School Locator.
Growth around the stations is guided by the City Centre Plan on surrey.ca, which is worth a read before you buy near a site that could be redeveloped.

Whalley suits buyers who want to live close to SkyTrain and the City Centre offices and shops, and who like having lots of new buildings to choose from. It's often the first stop for first-time buyers and investors comparing condos.
It may suit you less if you want a quiet street and a big yard. Those are here, but you'll trade some walking distance to the stations for them.

Condo sellers here are often competing with similar units in the same building or the one next door. I'll help you show what makes yours different, and I'll order the strata paperwork early so a buyer's subjects don't drag on.

Pick the station you'd use most, then tell me your budget and the number of bedrooms. I'll send listings within a comfortable walk and flag the buildings I'd want to read more about before you book a viewing.

blocks.text: Is Surrey City Centre in Whalley?

parts.t: Yes. City Centre is the core of Whalley, around the Gateway, Surrey Central and King George stations.

blocks.text: How many SkyTrain stations are in Whalley?

parts.t: Three: Gateway, Surrey Central and King George.

blocks.text: When will the Surrey Langley SkyTrain open?

parts.t: Service is expected in late 2029.

blocks.text: Where does the name Whalley come from?

parts.t: From Arthur Whalley, whose 1925 gas station and store gave Whalley's Corner its name.

blocks.text: What is the biggest park in Whalley?

parts.t: Holland Park, about 10 hectares on Old Yale Road.
The City of Surrey plans for more growth in City Centre. Read the City Centre Plan on surrey.ca to see what is planned near a given street.

blocks.text: Are there houses in Whalley, or only condos?

parts.t: Both. Condos cluster near the stations, and houses and townhomes fill the streets around them.
